answer: A hardware attestation protocol resists Sybil attacks by logging verified identities in a network atlas. Each agent must pass an admission jetty where secure enclaves submit signed execution proofs. An attacker creating fake identities incurs the verifiable hardware cost of purchasing physical security chips per instance. Although challenge probes dive like a falcon to cull rogue emulators, a key limitation is that hardware side-channel leaks can compromise private attestation keys.
